thread:
sara-sales: Heads-up: ByteWave POC started a stress run at 13:05 PT and they're seeing intermittent 429s after bursts of quick chat queries. Can eng/ops help triage?

alex-eng: Can you pull a request_id and any response headers from their logs? We need route and X-Redwood-Quota headers, if present.

sara-sales: Got one: request_id=rwd-bw3k2, route=/v1/chat/completions, status=429, body={"error":"rate_limited","code":429,"request_id":"rwd-bw3k2","retry_after":2} from their harness.

mike-ops: Looking at telemetry for rwd-bw3k2: they fired ~10 parallel calls that averaged ~700 tokens each in a 3s window. Our per-tenant per-route token cap is 6k tokens/5s by default; they briefly spiked to ~7k so the token cap tripped.

aj: (ops note) Token accounting includes embeddings too. Are they doing any embedding ops in front of chat?

jules-ml: Good call. If their flow does an embedding per message for reranking, that multiplies token usage. Recommend caching or async precompute.

sara-sales: They confirm: one embedding per candidate before each chat. They can change behavior but want a temporary fix while validating.

mike-ops: I can provision a temporary per-tenant token bump for ByteWave for 36h (raise per-route cap 6k->12k tokens/5s). Want me to apply it now?

emily-sa: Please do. Also add instructions to the POC checklist: capture X-Redwood-Request-Id and X-Redwood-Quota-Remaining when you hit 429s and paste them into the ticket. Suggest they lower max_concurrency to 8 and max_tokens to 350 for the POC run.

alex-eng: For immediate mitigation on their side: lower max_tokens, cap parallelism, or move embeddings to a separate worker process. For platform improvements: consider exposing a "burst_window_ms" knob for POCs so sales can request smoother caps.

ratebot: [automated] quota-bump request created: ticket=RB-4399 assignee=mike-ops change=per-tenant-token-cap 6k->12k window=5s duration=36h.

mike-ops: Applied the 36h bump and enabled a one-per-minute extra burst allowance while we monitor. I'll watch telemetry for the next 2 hours and report back.

jules-ml: Repro tip for eng: run ~10 concurrent requests with max_tokens=700 and you'll see 429s after ~2-3s. Quick curl script: ```bash
for i in {1..10}; do curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"rw-chat-1","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"ping"}],"max_tokens":700}' &
done; wait
```

alex-eng: Thanks. I'll add a one-off alert on token-usage >80% of the provisional cap that will page #sales-oncall. Sara, can you ask ByteWave to rerun in ~30m and include response headers when a 429 happens? That makes triage much faster.

sara-sales: Yup, I'll coordinate and send a short checklist: 1) capture request IDs and response headers, 2) try max_concurrency=8 and max_tokens=350, 3) avoid per-message blocking embeddings if possible.

mike-ops: Monitoring shows stable usage after the bump so far. If we see sustained >12k/5s we'll revert and escalate to capacity planning for a short Dedicated trial.

emily-sa: If they want consistent high throughput, propose a Dedicated trial (reserved GPUs) — I'll draft pricing options and a short SLA addendum for the POC.

sara-sales: ByteWave prefers hosted for now but will consider Dedicated if this recurs. I'll post their rerun logs in this thread once they finish. :thumbsup:
